plos-pone-0356632: Metacognitive training helps people with psychosis question their own distorted thinking — but do men and women improve differently? plos-pone-0357232: This paper put montmorillonite-impregnated burnt-red clay through full microstructural and physicochemical characterization, with statistical evaluation of strength and durability. plos-pone-0358232: Potato cyst nematodes devastate crops — and their HYP1 gene varies in ways scientists couldn’t explain. plos-pone-0355932: Who gets to decide in rural Ethiopian households — on crops, on spending, on daily life? plos-pone-0357032: Vision loss is rising across the Gulf states — and planners need to see it coming. plos-pone-0357832: Some patients end up living in hospitals for months — with nowhere else to go. plos-pone-0339732: River dunes behave strangely where sand gives way to gravel. plos-pone-0352132: Racialized mothers in Canada face distinct postpartum mental health challenges that research has largely ignored. This scoping review protocol will systematically map the evidence on their experiences. The planned review centers mothers whom the literature has marginalized.
plos-pone-0344932: Preserving whole brains — even aldehyde-fixed ones — pushes cryobiology to its limits. This paper explored the cryopreservation of aldehyde-fixed whole brains. plos-pone-0355232: Teaching wears on the body as well as the mind. plos-pone-0355332: Bio-electrochemical reactors can strip organic carbon from wastewater — especially with nanoparticle help. plos-pone-0351932: Premature babies on intravenous nutrition need precisely verified doses — errors can be fatal. plos-pone-0353932: Young people with chronic conditions often fall off a cliff when aging out of pediatric care. plos-pone-0355832: Losing smell and taste was COVID-19’s strangest signature — and genes may explain who suffered it. plos-pone-0345032: Tirzepatide — the blockbuster diabetes and weight-loss drug — is judged by a triple endpoint. plos-pone-0335832: CDO1 gene methylation might distinguish gastric cancer from mere chronic gastritis. plos-pone-0353232: Academics timing parenthood around tenure face a cruel calculus. plos-pone-0343832: Tourists want drone photography — and cultural sites want it managed smartly. plos-pone-0355732: Cancer patients in acute care need navigation — and physiotherapists might guide them. plos-pone-0354232: Avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder — ARFID — starves adults who aren’t chasing thinness. plos-pone-0354132: Mint rhizospheres — the soil around roots — host microbial communities linked to the plants’ essential oils. plos-pone-0351332: Los Angeles County jails from 2008 to 2023 — detention duration, overdose, and COVID-19 intertwined lethally. plos-pone-0354732: Community mental health interventions need process evaluations guided by theory — but which frameworks? plos-pone-0352332: Post-COVID condition — long-term multidimensional health status with and without it. This cross-sectional study did so. The findings charted the lingering toll. plos-pone-0348432: Obese osteoporotic patients with hip fractures — gold wrist-assisted PFNA reducing complications and enhancing recovery. This paper demonstrated it. plos-pone-0353032: Japanese type 2 diabetics — urinary fetuin-A fragments stratifying diabetic kidney disease risk. This paper tested the association. The modified protein fragments flagged the kidneys at risk. Its value is early warning from urine. The work reads renal fate in a urine sample.
